description:
[Wicked Identity] Register a REAL wallet (no stake required). Needs your signature over identity_get_nonce's message; this tool never signs. Sandbox identities are registered by identity_sandbox_register instead.

Use when you want a lightweight identity record for your wallet, with a signature over the nonce message. Not for proving you are an agent (use identity_get_challenge next).

Behavior: writes state upstream (not read-only); needs the credentials or wallet signature noted above where applicable.

nonce.description: Nonce from a FRESH identity_get_nonce call.

signature.description: 0x-prefixed ECDSA signature over that nonce's message.

wallet.description: Your 0x wallet address on Base, or the sandbox wallet from identity_sandbox_register.

name: identity_register
